title: The 3 Best Luggage Under $150
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for luggage under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at luggage under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Samsonite Freeform 24-Inch Medium Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 24-inch expandable polypropylene hardshell, Dual 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved combination lock.
strengths: 8.5-pound empty weight leaves more of the checked weight limit for belongings
limitations: Shell scuffs and shows scratches more visibly than fabric-shell bags
Wheel housings wear faster under heavy repeated use than premium double-swivel designs

products.name: Samsonite Freeform Hardside Carry-On Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: Expandable polypropylene hardshell, Dual 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved combination lock.
strengths: Lightweight shell leaves more of the carry-on weight allowance for belongings
Hardshell resists crush damage in a packed overhead bin
limitations: No front laptop compartment or interior organization beyond basic straps
Shows scratches more visibly than textured shells
Wheel housings wear faster than premium double-swivel designs under heavy use
